status: PROPOSED — superseding version after swarm v0 (G1 blind 11/12, G5 objections, HAL_OPUS report). V0 is retained unchanged.

outcome_semantics.ADMIT: claim is eligible for a witnessed admission; the reducer may transition state
outcome_semantics.HOLD: claim is neither falsified nor earned; no transition; stays on the frontier
outcome_semantics.REJECT: claim is falsified or structurally inadmissible as stated; no transition
outcome_semantics.NO_TRANSITION: no governed transition is in question; HELEN stays out

KEEP.text: Observation does not entail Cause (O ⇏ I ⇏ C). A derivation from DECLARED assumptions is permitted when the assumptions are in the claim package; silent derivation of I or C from O is forbidden.

Generation does not grant Authority. For a transition judged consequential or uncertain by a party other than the proposer (operator, HAL, or a declared policy), the proposal cannot self-authorize. The proposer's own declaration that uncertainty is absent never exempts it.

No valid witnessed Admission ⇒ no transition of X, where X is the governed state: ledger-recorded admitted claims and grants. ΔX is measured on X only; changes outside X are not transitions but must be receipted when they feed X.

REVISE.now: Remove(M) ∧ Preserve(E) ⇒ M is not established as necessary for E (another sufficient mechanism may exist).
VerificationValue = f(Independence, Reliability, Coverage). Independence is necessary for value, not sufficient; a heterogeneous but unreliable or partial verifier does not earn admission.
Conditional: ConsequentialUncertainTransition ⇒ proposal cannot self-authorize. Trivial deterministic cases are out of scope.
Cognition may loop (O↔T↔J↔W). Only the sovereign boundary is linear: Candidate → ValidAdmission → Reducer → State.
Color is a projection of a typed receipt, never its source. Color(S) ⇏ S.

ADDED.text: Null-field semantics. (a) Null EVIDENCE for a claim ⇒ HOLD: not established, not falsified. (b) Null PRECONDITION of an admission request (lineage/supersedes, witness) ⇒ REJECT of that admission request as stated; the underlying claim may be re-submitted. (c) A claim of EQUALITY between two objects where one lacks the compared property ⇒ REJECT: the equality is falsified, not merely unestablished.

fixtures.name: valid observation, invalid causal inference

given.observation: EGR fell 40% in week 41; scheduler cadence was changed in week 40.

fixtures.claim_under_test: The scheduler change caused the EGR drop.

expected.reason: Temporal succession is recorded as 🔵 observation. The causal claim has null counterfactual and null sham ⇒ N1(a): HOLD. Not falsified, not earned.

fixtures.isolates: O ⇏ C with the observation itself fully valid.

fixtures.name: strong model consensus, no independent witness

expected.reason: Agreement among same-type verifiers is repetition, not corroboration (R2). Null independent check ⇒ N1(a): HOLD. Consensus is not a falsification, so REJECT is wrong.

fixtures.isolates: Count of verifiers vs independence of verifiers.

fixtures.name: mechanism removed, effect preserved

given.sham: N1 → coating applied → N1 (blur perceived, identical rendering)

fixtures.claim_under_test: The coating causes the perceived blur.

expected.reason: Mechanism not established as necessary. Not falsified either: a second sufficient mechanism may exist (R1).

fixtures.isolates: The revised law: removal + preservation ⇒ not-necessary, not ⇒ false.

fixtures.name: corrected claim with lineage

expected.reason: Witnessed admission (result PASS, high reliability, full coverage incl. lineage) with C1 retained ⇒ ADMIT; C1 stays readable as historical state.
C1 erased and supersedes null ⇒ N1(b): the admission request is REJECTED as stated even with a valid witness. Correction ≠ Erasure.

fixtures.isolates: Lineage as a precondition of admission, independent of evidence quality.

fixtures.name: redundant witness vs heterogeneous witness

expected.reason: Independence = 0 regardless of reliability and count; R2 makes independence necessary ⇒ HOLD.

witnesses.coverage: full statement; Lean statement checked faithful to T by a human reader

expected.reason: One witness with a different failure mode, high reliability, full coverage with the statement's faithfulness to T checked ⇒ ADMIT.
Heterogeneous but weak: low reliability and partial coverage. JESTER's counter-case to the old law.

fixtures.isolates: f(Independence, Reliability, Coverage) — each variant zeroes one factor.

fixtures.name: MANUCURIST request that already exists

given.request: A tool to visualise the colour on my skin tone.

expected.reason: NEW requires Missing. The existence check falsifies Missing ⇒ the NEW_PRODUCT claim is REJECTED by falsification, not by null. The request stays 🔵; the gap diagnosis is a separate HOLD pending requirement fit (N1(a)).

fixtures.isolates: Rejecting the NEW label without discarding the signal.

fixtures.name: DIRECTOR causal sham
fixtures.isolates: A passing artifact with a falsified causal component: the recovery claim and the grammar claim get different outcomes.

expected.reason: R_O = 0.41 is below the declared threshold 0.70 and indistinguishable from the sham (0.40). The recovery claim is falsified.

variants.claim_under_test: The film establishes the causal grammar.

expected.reason: Identity and state change are recovered; the operator is not. ArtifactPass ⇏ GrammarEstablished (R1 form): the grammar is not established as necessary, and not falsified as a whole.

fixtures.name: trivial deterministic case where HELEN should stay out

expected.reason: No consequential governed state is in question. Running T→J→W→A here would be waste, not rigour.

fixtures.name: survivor without search history
fixtures.claim_under_test: Report A's result (0 duplicates) has the same epistemic status as Report B's (0 confirmed of 61 flagged among 6328 pairs).

expected.reason: Same survivor count, different provenance: A lacks search history ⇒ N1(c): the equality claim is falsified. SearchHistory ⊂ EpistemicProvenance.

fixtures.isolates: Survivorship bias as a structural defect of the receipt, not of the claim.

revision_log: L1: explicit-assumption derivations permitted when assumptions are declared in the claim package; only silent derivation forbidden.
L2: the 'consequential or uncertain' trigger is judged by a party other than the proposer; a proposer's own 'uncertainty=none' never exempts.
L3: X defined as the governed state (ledger-recorded admitted claims and grants); dX measured on X only.
R2: independence is necessary for verification value, not sufficient.
F7 split into F7a (operator recovered -> REJECT, threshold and sham R_O now given) and F7b (causal grammar established -> HOLD).
F4a: witness now carries result, reliability, coverage.
F5b: coverage states that the Lean statement was checked faithful to T by a human reader.
F6: reason restated as falsification of 'Missing' by the existence check, not as a null-field judgement.
F9: Report B placeholders replaced by receipted numbers from the dedup probe (6328 pairs, 61 flagged, 0 confirmed).
Blind export strips name, boundary and isolates (G5/HAL leakage finding); freeze test checks the blind file for outcome words in the fixtures section.
Glyph: the non-palette blue square replaced by the palette blue circle (observed).
